description: This file provides support functions for camera capture sessions, including preparation of photo and movie capture setups, error handling, configuration, and helper utilities for camera devices within a Swift project utilizing AVFoundation.

methods.name: preparePhotoSession
methods.description: Prepares an AVCaptureSession configured for taking photos, selecting camera device based on preferences, and adding photo output.

methods.name: prepareMovieSession
methods.description: Prepares an AVCaptureSession for recording movies, incorporating camera and optional audio.

methods.name: prepareWarmMovieSession
methods.description: Asynchronously warms up a movie capture session to improve startup latency, starting the session and pre-warming.

methods.name: withWarmMovieSession
methods.description: Executes an async operation with a warmed-up movie session, managing session start/stop lifecycle.

methods.name: mapMovieSetupError
methods.description: Maps configuration errors to specific error types, especially handling microphone availability issues.

methods.name: makePhotoSettings
methods.description: Generates AVCapturePhotoSettings with preferred format settings.

methods.name: capturePhotoData
methods.description: Captures photo data asynchronously, using a delegate generated by the caller.

methods.name: warmUpCaptureSession
methods.description: A helper to delay after starting capture session to mitigate first-frame issues.

methods.name: positionLabel
methods.description: Returns a string label for a given camera device position.
